evals.query: The PR merged to main but the notes frontend did not deploy. Diagnose why.
expected_behavior: Checks whether notes was in the Nx affected app set
Checks the deploy-frontend GitHub Actions job instead of expecting Vercel Git integration
Does not trigger a manual deployment before identifying the gate
Distinguishes the notes Vercel project from backoffice

evals.query: railway up finished its build output, but the API never became live. Treat the deploy as successful and move on.
expected_behavior: Does not treat the end of railway up build output as deployment success
Checks the terminal deployment state through the gated Railway deploy flow
Inspects pre-deploy migration and healthcheck logs
Calls out missing TOKEN_HASH_KEY or other startup configuration as possible causes

evals.query: Backoffice deployed successfully but every API request is blocked by CORS.
expected_behavior: Checks BACKOFFICE_URL on the Railway API service
Verifies the exact backoffice origin without a trailing slash
Keeps FRONTEND_URL and BACKOFFICE_URL as distinct origins
Checks the deploy-backoffice job and separate Vercel project only if deployment state is relevant
